title: FrameOS group box geometry invariant holds on every write path
defect: reconcileGroups was only wired into a few actions, so every other path that mutates nodes re-broke the 'group box == bbox(live members) + 28' invariant that createGroup/arrangeGroup/moveGroup all honour. Measured: 一键整理 left the box untouched while re-laying every node (drift x/y/w/h); dragging a member did not move the box (drift x/w/h); the debug-mode node panel's delete button left a dangling member and an un-shrunk box -- the same defect Batch 328 fixed, reached through a second path.
fix: reconcileGroups now recomputes unconditionally (the old `unchanged` short-circuit only looked at memberIds, so a wholesale member move never recomputed the box), and the store's write entrypoint is wrapped by enforceGroupGeometry so every action -- present or future -- converges once. Groups whose values do not change keep their object identity so Batch 333's persistence subscription does not rewrite identical content.
clone_decision: 'the box follows a dragged member' is derived from the clone's own invariant. Whether the source site allows dragging a member out of a group, and whether it auto-ungroups, was NOT sampled (blocked by the human-verification gate, see SOURCE_ACCESS_BLOCKED_2026-10-01.md). No drag-out-ungroup behaviour was invented here.
